title: Library Checkout System Lets Ineligible Patrons Take Books
description:
A small library checkout system spanning 5 files across 4 layers (models, repository, eligibility rules, service, route handler). `is_eligible(patron, book, repository)` should approve a checkout only if **all** of: the patron has no overdue books, the patron is under the 5-book limit, and a copy of the book is available. Right now patrons who shouldn't qualify are getting approved — and even checkouts that get correctly denied still mutate inventory and patron records. There are **multiple bugs across different files**. Trace the whole flow (`routes.py` -> `checkout_service.py` -> `eligibility_rules.py` -> `repository.py`) before changing anything.

**Entry point**
`handle_checkout_request(patron_id, book_id, repository) -> dict`

**Eligibility rule**
Approved only if `not has_overdue_books` AND `books_checked_out < 5` AND `copies_available > 0`.
